name: One-shot tuned on HAI feedback
display_label: V4 — One-shot tuned on HAI feedback
description: Same shape as baseline (one LLM call over the full doc) but the system prompt is augmented with 12 hand-distilled DON'T rules and a handful of few-shot exemplars drawn from Naomi and Angie's 876 graded annotations. The rules target the recurring failure modes: 'not specific to AI', duplicates, sentence fragments, and over-tagging on generic business language.
